title: Mr. Wasswa Teaches Children
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Mr. Wasswa as he teaches at Soroti Primary School, helping children learn and grow.
keywords: teacher, school, education, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, learning
dedication: For all the teachers who shape young minds with patience and love.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: What does a teacher do? Join Mr. Wasswa as he helps children read, count, and discover the world. A story about wisdom and patience.
